## Notes

### Quick read
- Katherine is a pregnant second-time mom (blonde bob, high energy "Moms, RUN" sale yapper) with no baby to wear yet, and her two sale videos made $2,149 GMV from just 2 ads.
- Best next move: answer her unanswered Sep 22 message with ideas plus a simple explanation of the rejections (two were duplicates, one was caught by the program pause), and steer her to pregnancy and "packing my hospital bag" style content that does not depend on a sale.

### Style (from watching her videos)
- Who she is on camera: expecting mom, "second-time mom" per her script, blonde bob, Apple watch, casual tees (blue, green, olive). Films at home in a living room with a robot vacuum and wall art. No baby or toddler appears in any video. Uses the Light Palms sling, worn empty.
- Format: yapper, very high energy, close to the lens, big hand gestures, fast talker, sale urgency every time. 18 to 30s. Shows the sling coming out of the mailer bag, putting it on, pointing to the padded strap and buckle.
- Hooks (quote, text overlays): "MOMS... THIS IS ON SALE", "Moms, RUN. It's On Sale", "WAIT...IT'S ON SALE", "IT'S FINALLY ON SALE", "WORTH THE WAIT". VO: "Proven fact that things are better on sale, especially if you've been waiting for them."
- What worked: 14a5745d ("Moms, RUN. It's On Sale", unboxing then putting it on) and 8e526443 ("WAIT...IT'S ON SALE") were approved and each ran as an ad; $258 earnings, $2,149 GMV, 31 conversions, ROAS 1.39. The "expecting mom snatching it on sale" angle clearly converts.
- What got rejected: b4e77552 and cd087a2a were the same video with a different text hook ("IT'S FINALLY ON SALE", "WORTH THE WAIT"), rejected as duplicates. 5b2e8e92 (Sep 14) was rejected only because the old program was paused; she took it as a quality rejection.
- Safety and checklist issues seen:
  - 5b2e8e92: says "0 to 4 months" and "holds up to 50 pounds". Our rule is to state the range as a weight only (10 to 50 lbs), never an age.
  - No baby means no seat, hand or M position shown; fine for her situation, but the sling looks like an empty bag. Pointing at the sling is her main demo.
  - The "back-to-school special" mention in all her scripts is now dated.
- Strengths to lean on: huge energy and conviction, strong direct response delivery, relatable pregnant mom angle.
- To improve: newer, evergreen hooks not tied to one sale; show the weight range correctly; once baby arrives, the real demo will be the big unlock.
